plugins.name: create-pr
plugins.description: Create HMCTS APIM pull requests with JIRA integration — extracts ticket from branch, drafts rich PR descriptions, and transitions JIRA status

plugins.name: wire-claude-context
plugins.description: Create the gitignored .claude/CLAUDE.md that wires shared team standards into the local Claude session — run once per repo per developer, then use /init to generate the committed CLAUDE.md

plugins.name: openapi-spec-reviewer
plugins.description: Review HMCTS OpenAPI v3 specs against four lenses: data-sharing policy (UK GDPR/DPA 2018), infrastructure SLA (Azure APIM/AKS), HMCTS API standards, and security standards — returns a scored report with Critical/Warning/Info findings

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Cut a GitHub release for any APIM service — finds PRs merged since last tag, filters noise, computes next version, generates functional changelog, and creates the release via gh CLI

plugins.name: review-checklist
plugins.description: Structured pass/fail PR review checklist covering correctness, tests, security, code quality, dependencies, docs, and CP Service Patterns (T1–T5 feature toggles, M1–M3 mappers, V1, I1, N1)
